annotations.title: Should I engage? (screen a lead, sender, vendor or website)

description: Screens a lead, sender, vendor or website and returns an engage-or-not answer. Input: any of domain, url, email, phone or company_name, the context (lead, inbound_email, partnership, vendor, purchase, marketplace_seller, agent_action), an optional amount (USD) and a policy (strict, balanced, permissive; default balanced). Returns engage (true or false), risk (low, medium, high, unknown), confidence 0 to 1, subject_type, reasons (each with source and evidence), mitigations, checks, a read (headline, recommendation engage | verify_first | do_not_engage, failed checks, lookup links) and a signed receipt_id. Deterministic, no AI in the decision, usually under a second. A possible sanctions name match returns engage=false with 'manual review', not a finding. For individuals only technical checks of the address, phone or domain run. engage is advisory. Rules: https://jid.com/screen-rules. Counts as 1 check with a key; free tier without one.
